sentences.en: The angler felt a strong tug on the line.
sentences.zh: 渔夫感到钓线上有强烈的拉力。

sentences.en: Its massive gravity well tugs many asteroids from the outer belt inwards.
sentences.zh: 它的巨大引力场会把许多小行星从外带拽向内侧。

sentences.en: How do you train a dog not to tug on its leash?
